notes.title: Errors Fixed
notes.content: Some bugs in the game have been fixed.

notes.title: Giant Animal Bug is Fixed
notes.content: The attack bug of giant animals has been fixed.

notes.title: Teleport Bug fixed.
notes.content: The teleport system, which was broken after the last update, has been fixed.

notes.title: The game is now more optimized and the teleportation bug has been fixed
notes.content: Increases in FPS have been corrected and the game is more optimized. I hope you enjoy playing the game even more.

notes.title: Maps Update
notes.content: It is now easier to find directions with maps. You can open the large map by clicking on the small map.

notes.title: Pet Defense Feature
notes.content: Now, with the pet defense feature, you can attack enemies from a safe distance behind the pet.
